title: Intrusion report and callback to the master number
body_md: An intrusion report is always received when the connected alarm system reports an alarm. After the message has been sent, Pro-finder additionally calls the master number.
source_region: Chapter 4, explanation of the message type “Intrusion report” with red addition
prev_context: Before this stands the help message.
